newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 dives again led by major issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 dives again led by major issues.

text.p: Czech major issues, Komercni Banka, CEZ and SPT Telecom continued to decline on Wednesday pushing the PX50 index sharply lower.
Analysts said the fall of the PX50 was caused by profit taking after strong gains earlier in the year and was also part of a region-wide trend affecting Budapest and Warsaw as well.
"I think it's not just the Czech Republic it is a regional trend. It is the same in Hungary and Poland," said John Vax of ING Barings.
Komercni dropped 100 crowns, 3.8 percent, to 2,535, CEZ fell 47 crowns, 4.1 percent, to 1,101 and SPT lost 150 crowns, 3.9 percent, to 3,650.
Petr Opocensky of Citicorp Securities said the shares had been been hit by profit taking but he could not foresee any quick turnaround.
"We see the main reason being profit taking which started the trend but now we are not quite sure about recovery. So people are in wait and see mood," he said.
Overall, activity was moderate with turnover at 1.3 billion crowns.
